scale: Each criterion scored 0, 1, or 2. 0 = absent or wrong. 1 = present but partial. 2 = fully met. Score only what the output says; do not credit the model for what it probably meant.

criteria.text: Every factual claim in the output traces to the source material. Any claim not supported by a fixture scores 0 for this criterion regardless of how minor it seems.
Conflicts between sources are named as conflicts rather than silently resolved in favour of one source.
Conflicts the evidence cannot settle are explicitly marked unresolved. Confidently resolving an unresolvable conflict scores 0.
Conflicts the evidence CAN settle are in fact settled, with the settling evidence cited. Marking everything unresolved is not caution, it is failure to do the work.
The output is in the requested form and length. A three-page answer to a one-page request scores 0.
Written for the stated reader. A brief for a VP that opens with methodology rather than the finding scores 1 at most.
